failures.cause: Both new full experiments exceeded inherited Nextest default 60-second watchdog. Default retry then correctly failed create-only paths with AlreadyExists.
failures.resolution: Dedicated opt-in qualification group, one thread, zero retries, bounded 20-minute experiment watchdog; worker/request/child deadlines and quality gates unchanged.

failures.cause: Four unsupported requests with multiple literal date cutoffs were incorrectly surfaced by host TimeView as resolver infrastructure errors.
failures.resolution: Use a typed host abstention for this unsupported temporal capability; preserve true infrastructure errors and all frozen Python/model/fixture bytes.

preservation: Original provider artifact ZIP retained in indexed chunks; exact original baseline errors, original partial trials and logs preserved. SUMMARY.json and REVIEW.json are derived views, never replacement raw receipts.

provider_log.representation: Exact UTF-8 encoding of the provider tool decoded log string; not a raw HTTP wire capture.
